result.reason: The revision removes the Licensor’s unilateral seven-year renewal right and makes renewal subject to mutual written agreement, satisfying the preferred mutual-renewal route. However, limiting mutually agreed renewals to 12-month increments is not required by that route and therefore changes more than necessary. Unrelated termination rights remain intact. Drafting quality is reduced by the retained malformed phrase “mutual written of the parties” and redundant renewal provisions.
